claims.evidence: Crypto prices continue to surge this morning, hitting levels last seen in January of this year. This morning's opening price for bitcoin and ethereum both mark gains of over 10% in the last week and month. Here's a look at how the opening bitcoin price has changed versus last week, month, and year: The price of ethereum this morning, Tuesday, September 22, 2026 , was 5% higher than Monday's open. Another major factor in the crypto price surge is short liquidations.
